description: Send delivered work back to the deliverer for changes (submitted → claimed) with a note saying what to fix; they re-deliver with submit_deliverable. Max 3 revision rounds per task — after that accept, dispute or cancel. Only the task creator can do this. Requires keypair auth.

note.description: What needs to change (required — the deliverer sees it)

task_id.description: The task ID whose deliverable needs changes

name: request_revision
